name: Union City Youth Commission
what_you_do: You speak for Union City teens to the City Council. You plan community events. You volunteer through the year. You also earn community service hours.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 7 to 12 who live in or go to school in Union City.
deadline_text: The page lists applications from February 1 to April 1, interviews in April and appointments in May. It gives no year, so treat this as last year's pattern.
how_to_apply: Submit an application between February 1 and April 1, then interview in April.
notes: Follow @UCTeens on Instagram for events, per the city page. The program runs out of the Kennedy Youth Center.
